NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 103 PM EST Sun Nov 8 2026

- Milder and breezy today with gusts up to 30 mph. 

- Gradual warm up early this week with highs climbing into the low 
60s Tuesday. 

- Rain chances increase late this week ahead of a cool down.

&&

.AVIATION...

Low pressure passing to the north with an attendant cold front is 
leading to increasingly southwest to west wind gradient this 
afternoon. Wind gusts of 25-30 knots is expected through the 
remainder of the afternoon. Increased low level moisture ahead of 
this front is bringing a corridor of MVFR ceilings, but should 
remain focused north of the south metro terminals for the next 
couple hours. Have maintained tempo groups for these ceilings. 
Eventual lifting to low VFR for the TAF sites later this afternoon 
into tonight. Gusts ease but will stay sustained to around 10 knots.
Dry frontal passage expected with maybe some spotty showers nearby 
to the east of KMBS and KFNT. 

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* Medium for ceiling at or below 5000 ft this afternoon into tonight.
